# dsh-control-bar

Whenever the agent starts driving your computer (moving the mouse, typing, running commands
that cha

nge state), a slim status bar stays pinned to the top of the screen: **正在操控**
(“controlling”) plus w

hat it is doing right now, an honest percentage, and a badge telling you
whether DeepSeek is current
ly in **peak** or **off-peak** pricing hours.

Peak tokens cost twice as much as off-peak ones, so the plugin also ships a policy:
**expensive oper
ations ask for your confirmation during peak hours, and just run off-peak.**
中文说明
## Install

In DSH Desktop: **Plugins → Plugin Market**, search `dsh-control-bar`, install, restart.
Or from a C
LI (`desktop` = your profile name):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or straight from the repository (same thing before the npm release; there is no build step):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The bar is a separate Electron process, so it needs an Electron binary. Lookup order:
`overlay.elect

ronPath` → `DSH_CONTROL_BAR_ELECTRON` → `DSH_ELECTRON_PATH` → `$DSH_HOME/electron`
→ `~/.dsh/electro

n` (installing dsh-pet puts one there).
If nothing is found the bar is skipped, everything else keep

s working, and the host logs
`overlay not running (electron-not-found)`.
## Usage
Nothing to do after installing, and nothing the model has to remember — the bar follows the agent's
**turn**, the same way codex's status line does:
| Host event | Bar |

| `turn/start` | appears with "正在工作" / "正在处理你的请求" at 4% |
| every `tool/call` | label switches to wh

at is happening (执行命令 / 读写文件 / 查资料 / 操作浏览器…), progress advances on a monotonic curve |
| `turn/end`
or `agent/error` | fills to 100% ("完成"), waits 1.2 s, then hides itself |
A turn that is interrupted, fails, or is simply forgotten can no longer leave a bar hanging on scree

n.
`control_bar` still works (`start`/`update`/`finish`/`hide`) when the model wants to report an ex

act
percentage while driving your desktop.
Manual control, also handy from scripts:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Peak / off-peak windows
| | Beijing time | Price |
| Peak | Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 (UTC 01:00–04:00, 06:00–10:00), excluding statutory hol

idays | ×2 |
| Off-peak | everything else, including weekends and holidays | ×1 |

Off-peak rates are half of peak rates per DeepSeek's pricing notes. Public holidays for 2026 are
bun

dled, so the check needs no network. Override `pricing.windows` / `pricing.holidays` if your
account
uses a different schedule.

Gate rules written into the system prompt: during peak, a large token operation (default
threshold ≈

200k tokens) must write `text:"峰时大额操作，等你确认"`, ask you with three options
(do it now / wait for off-

peak / narrow the scope) and only continue after you pick one; off-peak
it just runs; small reads ar

the scope) and only continue after you pick one; off-peak
it just runs; small reads are never gated.

## Privacy

No network calls, no telemetry. The overlay only reads a local `state.json` (a number and a
string).

Its renderer is sandboxed, unfocusable, and click-through, so it never blocks the window
you are wo

erer is sandboxed, unfocusable, and click-through, so it never blocks the window
you are working in.
